hero.subtitle: Fantasy cycling with friends. Live auctions, real UCI races, pure strategy.

auction.title: Draft at auctions
auction.text: Browse the peloton, filter by price or UCI category, and bid on the riders you want. Limited budget, strategic choices — every bid counts against your opponents.

team.title: Build your team
team.text: Climbers, sprinters, rouleurs — up to 30 riders in your squad. Track their points in real time, optimize your roster phase after phase and aim for the perfect team.

ranking.title: Follow the pro calendar
ranking.text: Full UCI calendar with WorldTour, ProSeries and .1 races. Check startlists, anticipate results and plan your strategy race by race.

classement.title: Dominate the rankings
classement.text: General, weekly, by rider or chrono rankings — multiple ways to shine. Compare yourself to friends and climb to the top of your league.

auction.title: Who will recruit
auction.subtitle: The auction between friends is the heart of the game. Strategy, bluff and adrenaline.

quote1.text: The auctions are the best part! We challenge each other to get Pogačar.
quote1.author: Marie L.

quote2.text: Our league has been running for 3 years. Every Tour, it's always as intense!
quote2.author: Guillaume R.

cta.title: Ready to start
cta.subtitle: Invite your friends and start playing today.
